summary.title: Zaad (character)
summary.name: Zaad
summary.excerpt: Zaad is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. It shares together with his creator the title as one of the seven Demonlords of Nogreth.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Zaad is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. It shares together with his creator the title as one of the seven Demonlords of Nogreth.

sections.title: In Brave Frontier I
sections.content: As part of the Battles of Brave Frontier 2 series, Zaad can be fought in The Warmonger. The fight serves as a reference to how players can challenge Zaad in Trial No. 4 in Brave Frontier II.

sections.title: In Brave Frontier II
sections.content: Zaad made its first debut as a major antagonist alongside its creator Gustaph in Rin's Chapter 1 at Bada-Fana. Much later in the story, it made its return in Chapter 9.
